Find the general rule for the pattern formed by matchsticks making 'L' shapes, given the sequence is 2, 4, 6, 8. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The sequence is composed of multiples of 2. Therefore, if 'n' represents the position number, the general rule is simply 2n.

questions.question_text: Classify an angle measuring exactly 180 degrees and explain its shape. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: An angle measuring exactly 180 degrees is classified as a straight angle. It appears perfectly flat, resembling a single straight line.

questions.question_text: Write the prime factorization of 36 using a factor tree method. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Splitting 36 gives 2 and 18. Splitting 18 gives 2 and 9. Splitting 9 gives 3 and 3. So, the prime factorization is 2 x 2 x 3 x 3.

questions.question_text: A data set contains the numbers: 5, 8, 5, 12, 5, 9. What is the frequency of the number 5? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The frequency is the number of times a specific value appears. The number 5 appears exactly three times in the set, so its frequency is 3.

questions.question_text: Check if 834 is divisible by 6 using divisibility rules. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: 834 ends in 4, so it is divisible by 2. The sum of its digits (8+3+4=15) is divisible by 3. Since it is divisible by both 2 and 3, it is divisible by 6.

questions.question_text: Define intersecting lines and give one real-life example. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Intersecting lines are two lines that cross each other at exactly one common point. A real-life example is an open pair of scissors or a crossroads.

questions.question_text: Find the Least Common Multiple (LCM) of 12, 15, and 20. Show your steps. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Prime factorize: 12 is 2x2x3, 15 is 3x5, 20 is 2x2x5. To find the LCM, multiply the highest powers of all prime factors present: 2x2x3x5. The calculation gives 60. Thus, the LCM is 60.

questions.question_text: The marks obtained by 10 students out of 20 are: 15, 18, 12, 15, 19, 15, 14, 18, 15, 12. Organize this data in a frequency distribution table using tally marks. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: We list the unique marks: 12, 14, 15, 18, 19. Tally marks: 12 gets || (frequency 2); 14 gets | (frequency 1); 15 gets |||| (frequency 4); 18 gets || (frequency 2); 19 gets | (frequency 1). Total students are 10.

questions.question_text: Determine the value of 'x' in the equation 3x + 4 = 19. Show the inverse operations used. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: First, subtract 4 from both sides of the equation, which leaves 3x = 15. Next, divide both sides by 3 to isolate x. This calculation gives x = 5.

questions.question_text: Draw an angle of 60 degrees. Name the vertex and the two arms. (Describe the steps clearly). [40-50 words]
questions.answer: Draw a straight ray AB with A as the starting point. Place the protractor center exactly on A. Mark a point C at the 60-degree mark. Draw a ray from A through C. Point A is the vertex; rays AB and AC are the arms.

questions.question_text: Find the Greatest Common Divisor (GCD) of 36 and 48. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Factors of 36 are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 12, 18, 36. Factors of 48 are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, 48. The common factors include 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12. The greatest is 12.

questions.question_text: A pattern is formed by adding consecutive odd numbers: 1, 1+3, 1+3+5. Find the sum of the first 6 odd numbers using a shortcut rule. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: The sum of the first 'n' consecutive odd numbers is equal to n squared (n x n). For the first 6 odd numbers, n = 6. Therefore, the sum is 6 multiplied by 6, which equals 36.

questions.question_text: In a class of 40 students, 1/4 like playing cricket, 1/8 like tennis, and the rest like football. How many students like football? [40-50 words]
questions.answer: First, calculate cricket fans: 1/4 of 40 is 10 students. Tennis fans: 1/8 of 40 is 5 students. Total for cricket and tennis is 10 plus 5, which equals 15. Subtracting this from 40 leaves 25 students who like football.

questions.question_text: Identify three pairs of parallel lines and two pairs of perpendicular lines on a standard rectangular wooden door. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: The top edge and bottom edge form one parallel pair; the left edge and right edge form a second parallel pair. Any horizontal panel lines are also parallel. A perpendicular pair is formed where the top horizontal edge meets either vertical side edge.

questions.question_text: A survey of 60 people's favorite fruits showed: Mango (25), Apple (15), Banana (10), and Grapes (10). Draw a bar graph representing this data. (Describe axes, scale, and bar heights clearly). [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Draw the X-axis for 'Fruits' and Y-axis for 'Number of People'. Use a scale of 1 unit = 5 people on the Y-axis. The Mango bar rises to 5 units, Apple to 3 units, Banana to 2 units, and Grapes to 2 units. Ensure equal spacing between all bars.

questions.question_text: Three bells toll at intervals of 10, 15, and 20 minutes respectively. If they all toll together at 8:00 AM, at what time will they next toll together? Explain your reasoning. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: They will toll together again after a time interval equal to the LCM of 10, 15, and 20. The LCM is calculated as 60. Therefore, the bells will toll together exactly 60 minutes, or 1 hour, after 8:00 AM. The next time they toll simultaneously is 9:00 AM.

questions.question_text: Using a ruler and compass, describe the detailed steps to construct an angle of 90 degrees starting from a straight line segment PQ. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Draw line PQ. Place compass pointer on a point O on PQ, draw a semicircle cutting PQ at A and B. With same radius, place pointer on A, mark an arc cutting the semicircle at C. From C, mark another arc D. From C and D, draw intersecting arcs above O. Join O to the intersection point.

questions.question_text: Rahul formed a shape using matchsticks where the number of matchsticks required to make 'n' connected triangles is given by the expression 2n + 1. Calculate the matchsticks needed for 1, 5, and 12 triangles. Show your substitutions. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Substitute 'n' into the expression 2n + 1. For n = 1, it is 2(1) + 1, which equals 3 matchsticks. For n = 5, it is 2(5) + 1, which equals 11 matchsticks. For n = 12, it is 2(12) + 1, equaling 25 matchsticks required.
